verdict.line: You lose if you trade into his 50+ Fury window or ignore his E (Slice and Dice) cooldown; you win if you time E (Apprehend) pulls for when his Fury is low and bleed him out across 15-20s of heavyweight.

brief.thesis: This matchup is decided by Renekton's Fury bar: below 50 Fury his W (Ruthless Predator) is a weak two-hit 0.75s stun, but above 50 it becomes a three-hit 1.5s stun that shreds shields and his Q (Cull the Meek) heal doubles. The 50.9% win rate over 3400 games reflects a lane where both champions have a real all-in, so the winner is whoever forces the fight on their own cooldown state rather than reacting to the other's.

theirWindow.when: Fury 50+ and E (Slice and Dice) up
theirWindow.what: Do not stand and trade here. His W becomes a 3-hit, 1.5s stun that breaks shields and his Q heal spikes, and he can E in to start it on his terms.

yourWindow.when: Fury under 50 or his E is down
yourWindow.what: This is when you commit. Land E (Apprehend) to pull him in, stack Hemorrhage with Q (Decimate) blade hits and autos, and he has no stun payoff and no dash to disengage.

start.why: 81.4% pick rate and the standard choice for a lane where you need early trade damage and sustain to answer his Q (Cull the Meek) poke-heal.

boots.why: 83.2% pick rate; his damage is almost entirely basic attacks plus his W/Q hits, so flat physical reduction outvalues Mercury's Treads here despite its stun.

core.why: First item on the strongest measured path (56.4% win rate over 326 games); the active haste lets you stick through his E (Slice and Dice) disengage.
Second item on that same path; the speed buildup closes the gap after he dashes away and the health keeps you alive through his W stun combo.
Completes the 56.4% win rate path; the damage-over-time conversion blunts his burst and keeps your Hemorrhage bleed ticking through his all-in.

situational.when: he is building lifesteal or you need to survive his level 6 Dominus all-in (64.5% win rate over 107 games, smaller sample)
the enemy team stacks magic damage beyond just Renekton (54.9% win rate over 144 games)

runes.keystoneWhy: The 46.4% win rate page builds this matchup around sustained melee trades; Conqueror's healing scales directly with the extended fights you want against his Fury-gated burst.

summoners.why: This combo posts the highest measured win rate at 51% over 26.6% of games; Ignite directly undercuts his Q (Cull the Meek) and R (Dominus) healing in the all-in windows this lane is built around.

playing.title: Punish empty E dashes
playing.detail: Renekton's only mobility and disengage is E (Slice and Dice) on a 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s cooldown. The moment he uses it to engage or reposition, land your E (Apprehend) and start stacking Hemorrhage.

playing.title: Read his Fury before committing
playing.detail: Below 50 Fury his W (Ruthless Predator) is only a 0.75s two-hit stun. At or above 50 it becomes a 1.5s three-hit stun that destroys shields. Never start a trade into the 50+ window.

playing.title: Hit the blade, not the handle
playing.detail: Q (Decimate) only heals off enemy champions struck by the blade edge. In extended trades, position so the blade connects to out-sustain his Q (Cull the Meek) self-heal.

playing.title: Slow his retreat with W
playing.detail: Crippling Strike's slow on your next attack is your answer to his E disengage. Hold it until he dashes away so he can't reset the fight on his terms.

playing.title: Time your R around his health pool
playing.detail: His R (Dominus) grants bonus Health and ongoing Fury regen, so Noxian Guillotine is only a guaranteed kill once Hemorrhage stacks are high enough that the true damage clears his buffed health bar.

playing.title: Fight at the edge of his Q
playing.detail: Per the measured matchup data, staying at max range of Cull the Meek denies his AoE heal while you still threaten with your own longer-reaching E (Apprehend) pull.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, win rates, and pick rates above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the Fury-threshold timing and trade-pattern reasoning are my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Fight Renekton while being wary of his Fury and Ignite. Try to hit him at the edge of [Q] while considering his Slice/Dice (E) when fighting him.
